prompt.content: Summarize the following essay: Technology monopoly is so wrong, its not even funny. Like, when one company controls everything, it sucks all the choices away from us. We can’t pick what we want cuz we have no options, and that makes everything expensive. Also, they don’t have to compete so they don't care about making stuff better. They just want more money. It messes up employment too, like smaller companies can’t hire people cuz they can’t compete. Plus, tech monopolies can spy on us more easier since nobody else is out there to stop them. Overall, it's unfair and everyone ends up losing but the big guys.

output: The essay argues against technology monopolies, asserting that they are detrimental to consumers, innovation, and employment. The author believes that when a single company dominates the market, it limits consumer choices, drives up prices, and stifles competition. This lack of competition leads to complacency in product improvement and prioritizes profit over quality
